verdicts.reason: A has the wrong reading order. The CTA is jammed into the top-left corner, the legal fine print is set larger than the headline and placed above it, the headline is shrunk to tiny type, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, and the logo is a speck crowding the button. B keeps the original structure, but it is a straight shrink of the portrait layout: the logo, eyebrow, body copy, the text on the CTA button, 'Ships late June' and the legal text are all too small to read at this size, and the headline takes up most of the canvas.
